keyword: did iran agree to a ceasefire
claims: As of April 7, 2026, Iran's Supreme National Security Council confirmed acceptance of a two-week, conditional ceasefire with the United States.
The agreement followed diplomatic efforts involving Pakistan and China.
Diplomatic efforts involving Pakistan and China aimed to halt attacks in the region and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
Reports suggested Israel agreed to pause its military campaign.
Iran agreed to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
The U.S. paused threats to target Iranian infrastructure.

The move led to a rise in stock markets.
